verdict: Paid channels are off; Google Business activity is now fading too.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads, so your Google Business Profile was the only channel generating engagement — 55 total actions including 33 direction requests and 21 website clicks. Over the past 7 days, GBP activity dropped 38%, and the last 4 days registered zero actions, which means organic visibility is softening with nothing in place to compensate. Website sessions are also trending down from their recent peak, consistent with the absence of paid support. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore lead flow, and we're addressing why GBP direction and click intent is not converting into phone calls.
